allow: PowerShell($env:Path; $lines = Get-Content ".env.local"; $url=\($lines | Where-Object {$_ -match '^NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL='}\) -replace '^NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=',''; $key=\($lines | Where-Object {$_ -match '^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY='}\) -replace '^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=',''; $url=$url.Trim\(\); $key=$key.Trim\(\); $h=@{ apikey=$key; Authorization="Bearer $key" }; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$url/rest/v1/contribuicoes?id=in.\(85,89,101\)&select=id,nome,email,valor,status" -Headers $h -ErrorAction Stop; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($lines = Get-Content ".env.local"; $url=\(\($lines | Where-Object {$_ -match '^NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL='}\) -replace '^NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=',''\).Trim\(\); $key=\(\($lines | Where-Object {$_ -match '^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY='}\) -replace '^SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=',''\).Trim\(\); $h=@{ apikey=$key; Authorization="Bearer $key" }; $ok=$false; for\($i=1;$i -le 8 -and -not $ok;$i++\){ try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$url/rest/v1/contribuicoes?id=in.\(85,89,101\)&select=id,nome,email,valor,status" -Headers $h -ErrorAction Stop; "OK try $i"; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $ok=$true } catch { "try $i ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } })
